verdict.rationale: Motion is a scheduling product, so exposing availability, bookings and event types to agents is a fair question. The evidence shows only a general REST API for creating and managing projects and tasks. Nothing shows an MCP server or any tool-calling surface that exposes scheduling availability, bookings or meeting templates to agents. The task/project API is an adjacent building block, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can use my scheduling account as a tool — an MCP server or tool-calling surface exposes availability, bookings, and event types
